Frequently.title: What's the difference between Power BI Pro, Premium, and Embedded?
Frequently.desc: Power BI Pro is a per-user license for creation and sharing of content. Premium can provide organizational scale and more data capacity. Embedded helps ISVs include analytics into applications with a per-capacity pricing model.

Frequently.title: Can Power BI connect to my existing systems like SAP, SQL Server, or Excel?
Frequently.desc: Yes, Power BI has native connections to a variety of systems: SAP, SQL Server, Excel spreadsheets, cloud applications, as well as on-prem databases, via secure gateways.

Frequently.title: Is Power BI secure and compliant for enterprise use?
Frequently.desc: Yes, definitely. Power BI has enterprise security features: you can have role-level access, encrypted data, auditing, etc., and Power BI complies with standards such as HIPAA and GDPR on-prem or in the cloud.

Frequently.title: Do I need a consultant if my team is already using Power BI?
Frequently.desc: Yes, a consultant can take your team to the next level by getting your team to adopt best practices in architecture/design, governance, performance, projects, and managing change processes. This speeds up deployment, eliminates common mistakes, and helps maximize ROI.

Frequently.title: What is Power BI Embedded, and when should I use it?
Frequently.desc: Embedded allows you to integrate Power BI visuals and functionality directly into your applications. It’s best for ISVs or products requiring analytics tools with flexible, usage-based pricing.

Frequently.title: Can I start with Power BI for free before committing?
Frequently.desc: Yes. You can use Power BI Desktop and trial Power BI Service for free. To share dashboards across your team, you'll need Power BI Pro licenses or Premium capacity.

Frequently.title: How do I choose the right Power BI license for my organization?
Frequently.desc: Selecting the right license depends on your user count, data volume, sharing needs, and performance requirements. Consultants can help assess your situation and recommend the optimal mix of Pro, Premium, or Embedded capacity.
